answer: Identity bond natural decay stops bulk fake identities. A newcomer posts a 40-credit bond tied to a kernel record of its work. The bond decays 4 credits each idle epoch, like shale flaking off a cliff, so dormant clones fade. Keeping 100 fakes alive costs 400 credits every epoch, 4,000 over ten epochs. An honest agent works in one oasis of verified tasks, restores its bond from earnings, and pays only once, keeping full rewards.
